# Avalanche Staking

> Avalanche Staking is a non-custodial interface for delegating AVAX to a validator on the Avalanche Primary Network P-Chain. Users sign every transaction from their own wallet. It is an independent tool and not an official Avalanche site.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Staking is done by delegating AVAX to a validator on the Primary Network P-Chain.
- AVAX usually starts on the C-Chain and is moved to the P-Chain by export and import, each with a small fee in AVAX.
- Delegation has a minimum amount and a fixed lock period of about two weeks up to one year, chosen by the user.
- The stake is locked for the whole period and returned with rewards at the end; rewards depend on validator uptime and validators charge a delegation fee.
- Avalanche does not slash delegated principal; the interface is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds.
